title: Extended Lines
pageTitle: Extended Lines: black and white photographs whose geometry leaks onto the page
ogTitle: Extended Lines: photographs whose lines leak beyond the frame
description: Six black and white photographs. The lines found in each one continue past the frame, then bend, echo and dissolve into the page. Turn one dial from photo to abstraction.
cardText: A small exhibition of black and white photographs. A line detector finds the geometry in each picture, and the page carries it on past the frame: lines extend, bend, echo and slowly fall apart into dots. One dial goes from plain photo to full abstraction.
imageAlt: Extended Lines: a black and white photo of an organ whose lines continue as thin rays across a dark page
